action.message:
I found the driving directions from Central Park, New York to Times Square, New York using the Car (OSRM) option:

**Route Summary:**
- Distance: 4.3 km
- Estimated Time: 8 minutes

**Step-by-step Directions:**
1. Start on unnamed road (20m)
2. Turn right onto 86th Street Transverse (500m)
3. Turn right onto 5th Avenue (3.2km)
4. Turn right onto West 45th Street (600m)
5. Turn left onto 7th Avenue (110m)
6. Reach destination (Times Square)

Directions courtesy of OSRM (FOSSGIS).
